data.title: Data use
data.description: How your data is used and shared.

email.label: I confirm that I agree to receive product news, offers and updates by email.
email.description: We will write to the email address of your account about this product and related offers. You can withdraw this consent at any time in your account settings, and every message contains an unsubscribe link. How we handle your data is described in the {{link}}.

sms.label: I confirm that I agree to receive offers and updates by text message.
sms.description: We will send text messages to the phone number you provide about this product and related offers. You can withdraw this consent at any time in your account settings. How we handle your data is described in the {{link}}.

phone.label: I confirm that I agree to be contacted by phone with offers and updates.
phone.description: We may call the phone number you provide about this product and related offers. You can withdraw this consent at any time in your account settings, and we will stop calling you. How we handle your data is described in the {{link}}.

push.label: I confirm that I agree to receive offers and updates as push notifications.
push.description: We will send notifications to the devices where you allow them, about this product and related offers. You can withdraw this consent at any time in your account settings or in your device settings. How we handle your data is described in the {{link}}.

profiling.label: I confirm that I agree that my activity in the product may be used to personalize what I see.
profiling.description: The pages you open, the actions you take and your preferences are analyzed to tailor recommendations, content and offers to you. You can withdraw this consent at any time and the personalization stops. Details are in the {{link}}.

partners.label: I confirm that I agree that my data may be shared with selected partners for their own marketing.
partners.description: Your name, email address and usage profile may be passed to selected partners so that they can contact you about their own products; each partner handles your data under its own privacy policy. You can withdraw this consent at any time, and sharing stops. Details are in the {{link}}.
